name: tradefloor
description: A trading desk for any market: analysts, bull/bear debate, trader, risk committee and portfolio manager over deterministic, point-in-time market data. Direction with calibrated probabilities, a sized trade plan, and a journal that scores every call.

interface.longDescription: Analysts, a bull/bear debate, a trader, a risk committee and a portfolio manager over point-in-time market data for any exchange. Direction with probabilities, a sized plan, and a scored journal.
defaultPrompt: Where is the Nifty 50 heading this month?
Which Nifty 50 stocks have strong intraday momentum right now?
How have my past tradefloor calls done?
